research_summary: The most important search gap is not another legacy Cuckoo review but a current post-transfer decision page. The implementation uses Cuckoo’s new Onestream-operated price and terms documents, corrects obsolete plan and router assumptions, compares SoGEA with FTTP, explains wholesale-network variation, surfaces unusually large ancillary and exit fees, and preserves an honest Awin state.
depth_rationale: Cuckoo’s ownership, product names, networks, billing and complaint routes changed in May 2026. A minimum 2,200 words is justified to separate legacy from current facts, cover ten speed tiers, costs, installation, add-ons and customer remedies without forcing readers to reconcile conflicting search results themselves.
